evidence: TQP-44 exact-corpus human PASS covering 25 stills, seven motion paths, twelve live scenes, four scales, and all required categories

TQP-47 retained rendered large-world frame, memory, queue, and applied-generation PASS
qualified_scope: TQP-44 accepted Windows complex visual and temporal corpus tied to the retained corpus signature
TQP-45 bounded Windows debug fast-arrival streaming and edit responsiveness
TQP-46 bounded Windows targeted collision residency and update latency
TQP-47 bounded Windows debug large-world rendering regression envelope
unqualified_scope: TQP-49 long-run complex adaptive soak and recovery
cross-hardware, non-Windows, production, GPU, and game-system claims
standards_changed: program manifest and qualification-state promotion mirrors
review: The human attestation accepts only the exact retained corpus. TQP-45 through TQP-47 promote only their measured Windows candidate envelopes; no production or cross-hardware performance claim is created.
downstream_impact: TQP-48 becomes the sole next dependency-ordered milestone. Gate E remains closed until TQP-48, TQP-49, and TQP-50 qualify.
